svg.title: Reinjection System - Engineering Drawings
svg.desc: Original treatment/reinjection diagrams. Key: 地热利用系统 = geothermal utilisation; 地热原水 = raw geothermal water; 开采井 = production well; 回灌井 = reinjection well; 除砂器 = sand separator; 粗过滤 = coarse filtration; 精过滤 = fine filtration; 排气罐 = degassing vessel; 供电系统 = power supply; 加压系统 = pressure boosting; 地下系统 = underground system; 排水口 = drain; 下位机 = field controller; 液位计 = level gauge; 压力表 = pressure gauge; 温度计 = temperature sensor; 流量计 = flow meter; 配电柜 = distribution cabinet; 变频柜 = variable-frequency-drive cabinet; 变压器 = transformer; 蝶阀 = butterfly valve; 单向阀 = non-return valve; 潜水泵 = submersible pump; 水位记录仪 = water-level recorder; 输电电缆 = electrical cable.
